title: Prime-Field Digit-Sum Dichotomy and Improved Three-Register Powering Exponents in Passive Catalytic Register Programs
description: Zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 formalization (verified across 5 distinct kernel implementations in 6 runs), exact-arithmetic and CaDiCaL 2.1.2 verification suite, deterministic vector figures, interactive Adaptive Forking cross-device workbench, and AMS-LaTeX preprint presenting new results on passive catalytic register programs extending Vinciguerra (arXiv:2609.18692; no question posed there is resolved), with a Boolean SAT companion related to Morse (arXiv:2608.30238). Preprint; not externally peer-reviewed.
